    guy_patches = image_patch.find("guy")
    stripe_patches = image_patch.find("stripes")
    
    if not guy_patches or not stripe_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    guy_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in guy_patches]
    stripe_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in stripe_patches]
    
    min_distance = float('inf')
    closest_guy = None
    
    for guy_center in guy_centers:
        for stripe_center in stripe_centers:
            distance_x = abs(guy_center[0] - stripe_center[0])
            distance_y = abs(guy_center[1] - stripe_center[1])
            total_distance = math.sqrt(distance_x**2 + distance_y**2)
            
            if total_distance < min_distance:
                min_distance = total_distance
                closest_guy = guy_patches[guy_centers.index(guy_center)]
    
    return closest_guy

        object_name = query
        object_patches = image_patch.find(object_name)

        # Return the first patch found
